<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 127.0997, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.0924 Da. The formula C₇H₁₂NO matches this mass (calculated 126.0919 Da, error ≈4 ppm), making it the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12NO</final_answer>
